instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: PropTech startup operating a platform for fractional real estate investment allowing retail investors to invest in commercial properties with as little as €100. 15,000 registered investors, €25M in funded properties. Regulated by CMVM. Evaluating automated property sourcing and due diligence workflow tools. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. We learned that good ideas need institutional backing to survive.
answers.strategicGoals: We are targeting a 20% improvement in operational throughput without increasing headcount. Our processes have grown organically over the years and are overdue for standardization. We suspect that workflow digitization, basic automation, and better data integration between our core systems can unlock significant productivity gains within our current cost structure.
answers.additionalContext: We are in the final stages of being acquired by a larger international group. The deal is expected to close in 3 months. The acquiring company has a strong reputation for technology-driven operations, and we anticipate significant investment in modernizing our systems post-acquisition. In the interim, we are in a holding pattern — major strategic decisions require acquirer approval, but we can prepare by auditing our current state and identifying quick wins.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 8 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Standardize Core Workflow Automation and Data Integration Layer
opportunities.rationale: The company has recognized the failure of informal processes (dashboard abandonment) and needs institutional backing for standardization. Integrating automated due diligence and property sourcing workflows will directly meet the 20% efficiency goal, creating a robust operational backbone vital for the pending acquisition.

first_actions: Map the end-to-end lifecycle of the primary investment product (from lead generation to fund closing).
Implement minimum viable automation flows between 2 core systems (e.g., CRM to Back Office Accounting).
Establish a permanent 'Process Owner' role responsible for maintaining and updating workflows, preventing knowledge silos.
resources_needed: Integration middleware platform license (low cost MVP)
Internal SME time allocation (20% of operations staff)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual processing hours for the core investment workflow by 15%.
milestones: MVP automation flow successfully tested with sandbox data.

opportunities.title: Develop an Acquirer Value Audit Package (Quick Wins)
opportunities.rationale: Given the acquisition is pending in 3 months, the immediate priority must shift from internal development to demonstrating operational excellence and minimizing perceived risk for the buyer. Creating a structured 'Audit Package' using existing data and identifying quick wins transforms preparation into tangible value.

first_actions: Conduct a gap analysis comparing current processes vs. industry best practices (Tech-driven benchmarks).
Document 3 specific, quantifiable operational improvements achievable in <60 days.
Create a detailed presentation and accompanying live demo for the potential acquirer's technical team.
resources_needed: External consultant guidance on M&A due diligence documentation
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful presentation of a 30-day operational improvement roadmap to the acquiring company.
milestones: Baseline process documentation finalized and audited internally.
Risk/Opportunity register completed for acquisition review.

next_steps.action: Formalize the roles and responsibilities for process ownership across departments to prevent knowledge loss.
Develop a detailed technical blueprint (TBP) outlining the ideal state architecture for system integration, serving as the primary document for post-acquisition planning.
Secure dedicated, ring-fenced funding (even if small) for continuous process improvement and automation tools during the holding period.

key_weaknesses: Dependence on informal knowledge retention: Critical processes are still housed in individual tribal knowledge rather than documented, owned workflows.
Lack of dedicated innovation funding: Progress is entirely contingent upon immediate operational needs or external investment (acquisition).
Siloed data management: Core systems lack sufficient integration, forcing manual reconciliation and hindering real-time decision making.

improvements: Structural maturity has improved significantly with the hiring of senior leadership and formalization of strategic planning.
The team's focus is now laser-targeted on quantifiable efficiency gains (20% throughput improvement).
Successful identification of automation gaps using current data.
persistent_gaps: The critical gap between *identifying* a process need and *implementing/sustaining* the solution remains due to lack of institutionalized processes.
Decision-making still requires high levels of executive sign-off, slowing down minor operational improvements.
Budgetary constraints continue to limit the scope of necessary technological overhauls.
achieved_milestones: The strategic goal (20% throughput increase) and focus area (digitization/automation) have been clearly defined.
A functional team structure is established, enabling professional planning.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has matured from a purely founder-led operation to one with formalized management structure and senior leadership. The focus has shifted decisively toward measurable efficiency gains and operational standardization in anticipation of acquisition.
